mapper.insert: INSERT INTO job_status_log (company_id, job_id, from_status, to_status, reason, reason_detail, operator_id, operator_role, request_id, created_at) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{jobId}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{reason}, #{reasonDetail}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorRole}, #{requestId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, company_id, job_id, from_status, to_status, reason, reason_detail, operator_id, operator_role, request_id, created_at, updated_at FROM job_status_log WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND job_id = #{jobId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
